sources.finding: Figure6-6 historically lists nine Moses South circuits: Massena-Marcy765, two Moses West-Adirondack230 circuits, Jay-Norton46, Alcoa-Brady115, AllensFalls-Colton115, two Dennison115 ties, and a Gilpin46 tie.
